newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-GALARRAGA, COOK SUSPENDED THREE GAMES APIECE.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-GALARRAGA, COOK SUSPENDED THREE GAMES APIECE.

text.p: Colorado Rockies slugger Andres Galarraga and Florida Marlins pitcher Dennis Cook were suspended three games each on Tuesday for sparking a bench-clearing incident last Saturday.
Galarraga charged the mound after being hit by a pitch from Cook, which National League president Leonard Coleman deemed was intentional.
Earlier in the game, Galarraga had blasted a mammoth 529-foot grand slam off Florida starter Kevin Brown that fuelled the Rockies' 8-4 victory.
Both Galarraga and Cook have appealed the suspensions and therefore are eligible to play pending the hearing of their appeals.
Both players were also fined an undisclosed amount.
